name: dsh-mcp-companion
description: Completes the DeepSeek Harness Skill/MCP panel with the servers another plugin mounts itself (wincu, the MCP resource bridge), gives those cards a real, persistent on/off switch, and adds an MCP chip to the New Session row that toggles MCP servers for the current conversation only, and adds two tabs to the Skill/MCP page: one tool definition per row with a switch, and one system-prompt section per row with a switch.
author: JamesDAdams
